title: Canonical chart and product normalizations of etale tensor powers
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $L$ a module sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the small affine model and its restriction equivalence [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model] and the existing tensor powers $P_d=L^{\otimes d}$ [def-trf-etale-module-evaluation-tensor-powers]. Define the chart identification $rP_d\simeq(rL)^{\otimes d}$ as the counit of that equivalence, and $P_1\simeq L$ as the inverse-equivalence image of the right unitor followed by the inverse equivalence unit. For a homogeneous algebra $A$ on $P_d$ [def-trf-etale-graded-module-algebra], say its products are canonical if its unit is invertible, on every small affine chart the product transported by this counit is the pure-tensor pairing followed by inverse concatenation, and the transported degree-zero unit is the identity on regular functions. These are equalities of actual sheaf sections, including degree zero; no global tensor-generation condition is imposed.
